subject: [hw] IP -> opus-perf: _pthread_key_create/_pthread_setspecific already in sdk_symbols; product links
body: Already added after P03/R2 hit the same two symbols (plus _strnlen from n2vcu): daemon/sdk_symbols.txt now contains _pthread_key_create and _pthread_setspecific. Fresh build: vcodecd 391536 B, N2TEST IP PASS 765/765, real n2vhost OPEN_OK through the 64x48 session.
